blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models are increasingly used to sample from a specified distribution, for instance, to simulate survey respondents or generate synthetic data. Instruction-tuned models can state such a distribution correctly and still fail to sample from it. Prompting and changes to decoding reduce this mismatch only partly, which motivates training with policy optimization. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) is a natural fit for this problem because it already samples a group of rollouts per prompt, and the group’s empirical distribution can be compared with the target. However, scoring the group as a whole gives every rollout the same reward. Group-relative centering then sets all advantages to zero, and the model receives no learning signal. To give each rollout its own signal, we introduce the witness advantage , a per-rollout advantage derived from maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). It trains a model to match a target distribution over a finite set of outcomes. The MMD between the model’s distribution and the target has a witness function that measures how over- or under-produced each outcome is. Each rollout’s advantage estimates the negative witness at its outcome, so a rollout is rewarded for an outcome the group under-produces and penalized for one it over-produces. The witness advantage is computed in closed form from the group’s outcome counts, and we use it as the reward in GRPO. On unseen target distributions, training with the witness advantage substantially reduces the total variation distance to the target while largely preserving the model’s general capabilities.
blocks.zh: 语言模型越来越多地用于从特定分布中取样,例如模拟调查答卷人或生成合成数据。 指令调制的模型可以正确表示这样的分布,仍然无法从中取样. 促动和改变解码只会部分减少这种不匹配,这激励了政策优化培训。 集团相对政策优化(GRPO)自然适合这个问题,因为它已经对每个即时推出的一组样本进行了抽样,集团的经验分布可以与目标进行比较. 然而,整个团体的评分给每个推出者都给予同样的奖励. 群相对中心化之后将所有优点设置为0,模型则不接收学习信号. 为了发出自己的信号,我们引入了证人的优势,即从最大平均差异(MMD)中获得的每次推出的优势。 它培训一种模式,以匹配一组有限结果的目标分布。 模型的分发与目标之间的MMD具有一种目击功能,可以衡量每个结果的产生多或少。 每次推出的优势都估计结果是负面的证人,因此推出的结果是对生产不足的团体的奖励,对生产过剩的团体的处罚。 证人的优势是根据小组的结果计算出来的,我们把它作为GRPO的奖励。 在未见的目标分布方面,具有证人优势的培训大大缩短了与目标的总变异距离,同时在很大程度上保留了模型的一般能力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Many real-world applications of a language model require it to generate samples from a specified distribution, for instance when simulating survey respondents ( Santurkar et al., 2023 ; Meister et al., 2025 ) , choosing actions according to a specified policy ( Misaki & Akiba, 2026 ) , or generating names, numbers, or coin flips ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Van Koevering & Kleinberg, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言模型的许多现实世界应用要求它从指定的分布中生成样本,例如模拟调查对象(Santurkar等人,2023年;Meister等人,2025年),根据特定政策选择行动(Misaki & Akiba,2026年),或生成名称,数字,或硬币翻转(Zhang等人,2024年;Van Koevering & Kleinberg,2024年).

blocks.en:
However, current models can identify the specified distribution but fail to sample from it. In our experiments, we evaluate an instruction-tuned model, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2024 ) . It correctly identifies the family and parameters of the specified distribution for five of six common distribution families (Figure 1 b), yet its samples remain far from that distribution. For a biased coin with P ⁡ ( Heads ) = 0.005 P(\text{Heads})=0.005 , the model places probability 0.678 0.678 on Heads (Figure 1 a). The error is therefore in the model’s output probabilities, not in the sampling step, so changing the decoding rule can only partly correct it. The best training-free method we test removes only 19 % 19\% of this error (Section 4.2 ).
Prior work finds this mismatch across many model families ( Meister et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Jang et al., 2026 ) . It also finds evidence that post-training moves a model’s samples further from the specified distribution ( Gu et al., 2026 ; Jang et al., 2026 ) . Prompting can improve sampling from stated distributions ( Misaki & Akiba, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , but it has limited success in our experiments (Section 4.2 ). To correct the mismatch between the stated and sampled distributions, we must therefore change the model’s probabilities themselves.
blocks.zh:
然而,目前的模型可以识别指定的分布,但未能从中取样. 在我们的实验中,我们评价一个指令调制模型,Quen2.5-1.5B-Instruct(Quen等人,2024年). 它正确地确定了6个共同分配家庭中的5个的家庭和指定分布参数(图1b),但其样本仍然远离这一分布。 对于带有P QQ(头)=0.005 P(\text{头}=0.005)的偏颇硬币,模型将概率为0.678 0.678(图1a). 因此,错误存在于模型的输出概率中,而不是在采样步骤中,因此改变解码规则只能部分纠正. 我们测试的最佳无训练方法只消除19%的这一错误(第4.2节)。
先前的工作发现,许多模范家庭存在这种不匹配现象(Meister等人,2025年;Gu等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年;Jang等人,2026年)。 它还发现有证据表明,训练后将模型的样本从规定的分布中进一步移动(Gu等人,2026年;Jang等人,2026年)。 催化可以改进对所述分布的采样(Misaki & Akiba, 2026;Zhang等人, 2026),但它在我们实验中的成功有限(第4.2节)。 为了纠正上述分配和抽样分配之间的不匹配,我们必须改变模型本身的概率。

blocks.en: Policy optimization ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) is a natural way to change these probabilities. It updates a model using rewards on the model’s own samples, so it suits objectives that are easy to evaluate but hard to supervise explicitly. Distribution matching fits this setting, since whether a model’s samples match a target distribution can only be evaluated over a group of samples. This motivates our central question: Can policy optimization teach a language model to sample from the distributions it states, and what property of the training signal enables it to do so?
blocks.zh: 政策优化(欧阳等人,2022年;肖等人,2024年;郭等人,2025年)是改变这些概率的自然途径. 它利用模型本身样本上的奖励来更新模型,因此它适合易于评价但难以明确监督的目标。 分布匹配符合此设定, 因为模型的样本是否匹配目标分布只能对一组样本进行评估 。 这引发了我们的中心问题: 政策优化能否教一个语言模型从它所描述的分布中取样,培训信号的什么属性使其能够这样做?

(b) On five families, the untrained model states the family and parameters correctly for 90 % 90\% to 100 % 100\% of targets, yet its median excess TV is 0.37 0.37 to 0.82 0.82 . blocks.en: The central design choice in policy optimization is the reward. To train a model to sample from a target distribution, the reward must measure how well the model’s samples match that distribution. This is challenging because a distribution is a property of many draws, whereas standard post-training rewards assign a score to each response individually. A natural approach is therefore to sample a group of outputs, compare their empirical distribution to the target distribution, and assign the resulting score to every sample in the group.
blocks.zh: 政策优化中的中央设计选择就是奖励. 为了从目标分布中培训一个样本模型,奖励必须衡量该模型的样本与该分布的匹配程度。 这一点具有挑战性,因为分配是许多抽奖的财产,而标准的培训后奖励则分别给每个答复分配一个分数。 因此,自然的做法是对一组产出进行抽样,将其经验分布与目标分布进行比较,并将结果的分数分配给该组的每一样本。

blocks.en: Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) is well suited to this setting because it already samples a group of rollouts for each prompt. However, GRPO centers advantages within each group, so giving every rollout the same distribution-level reward makes every advantage zero (Lemma 4 ). One plausible workaround is to divide the rollouts into several subgroups, score each subgroup according to its empirical distribution, and center these scores across subgroups. Training with this workaround does not lower the error (Figure 2 a). Supervised cross-entropy training on the target probability mass function (PMF) can make the model match the target distribution ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , but in our experiments it degrades the general capabilities of the model (Section 4.2 ). We therefore need per-rollout credit assignment that still reflects how well the group matches the target distribution.
blocks.zh: 集团相对政策优化(GRPO)(Shao等人,2024年)非常适合这一设置,因为它已经为每份快件抽取了一组推出的样本. 然而,GRPO中心在每一群体中都具有优势,因此,每次推出时都给予同样的分配级别奖励,使得每个优势都为零(Lemma 4 )。 一种合理的变通做法是把推广分成几个分组,按照每个分组的经验分布来评分,并将这些分数放在各分组之间。 以这种变通方式进行培训并不能减少错误(图2a)。 关于目标概率质量函数(PMF)的监督交叉进化训练可以使模型匹配目标分布(Zhang等人,2024年),但在我们的实验中它会降低模型的一般能力(第4.2节). 因此,我们需要按人计的信贷分配,这种分配仍能反映小组与目标分配的匹配程度。

blocks.en: To provide such a per-rollout training signal, we use the witness function of maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). MMD measures the discrepancy between two distributions, and its maximizing function, the witness function, identifies at each outcome how much it is over- or under-produced relative to the target ( Gretton et al., 2012 ) . On a finite outcome set with the exact-match kernel, the witness at an outcome is the difference between its model probability and its target probability. For each rollout, we estimate the negative witness function at its outcome using leave-one-out frequencies within the group, and use this estimate as the rollout’s reward in GRPO. A rollout therefore receives a positive reward when its outcome is under-produced relative to the target and a negative reward when it is over-produced. Unlike a group-level reward, this signal assigns credit to individual outcomes while still reflecting the mismatch of the group as a whole. Before GRPO subtracts the group mean, the resulting update is an unbiased estimate of the negative gradient of the squared MMD between the model’s outcome distribution and the target, and the subtraction adds only a bias of order 1 / G 1/G in the group size G G (Proposition 1 ). Section 4.2 shows that the size of this credit matters for outcomes with small target probability.
blocks.zh: 为了提供这种每卷的训练信号,我们使用最大平均差值(MMD)的目击功能. MMD衡量两个分布之间的差异,以及其最大功能,即目击功能,在每个结果中确定相对于目标,其产量多或少(Gretton等人,2012年)。 在精确匹配内核设定的有限结果上,一个结果的目击者是其模型概率与目标概率的区别. 对于每次推出,我们用小组内一个退出频率估计其结果的负面证人功能,并以这一估计作为推出在GRPO中的奖励。 因此,如果推广的结果与目标相比产量不足,则得到积极的奖励;如果推广结果过多,则得到不利的奖励。 与团体级奖励不同,这个信号为单个结果分配信用,同时仍然反映了整个团体的不匹配. 在GRPO减去组意指之前,由此产生的更新是对模型结果分布与目标之间平方的MMD的负梯度的无偏见估计,减法只增加了组意G大小(Proposition 1)中1/G1/G的偏差. 第4.2节表明,这种信贷的规模对于目标概率小的结果很重要。

blocks.en: To summarize, our key contributions are as follows. 1. We show that prompting and decoding have limited success in making a model sample from the distributions it states, because the model’s probabilities over outcomes are already wrong. We therefore use policy optimization to correct them (Section 4.2 ). 2. We introduce the witness advantage, a per-rollout advantage that enables GRPO to learn this task, and prove that, in expectation, training with it moves the model toward the target distribution. We also show when simpler rewards fail (Section 3 ). 3. We show that one to three GPU-hours of training substantially improve sampling on the training distributions, on unseen parameters and distribution families, and on stated opinion distributions and urn draws, while largely preserving general capabilities (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献如下。 1. 我们显示,促进和解码从它所描述的分布中得出模型样本的成功有限,因为模型对结果的概率已经是错误的。 因此,我们利用政策优化加以纠正(第4.2节)。 2. 我们引入了证人优势,即一种逐一推出的优势,使GRPO能够学习这项任务,并证明,在预期中,通过培训将模式推向目标分配。 我们还显示,当简单的奖励失败时(第3节)。 3. 我们显示,1至3小时的GPU培训大大改进了对培训分配、无形参数和分配家庭、公开意见分配和骨灰图纸的抽样,同时在很大程度上保持了一般能力(第4节)。

blocks.en: Related Work. Prior work closest to ours also scores each GRPO rollout using the other rollouts in its group. The reward of GAPO ( Anschel et al., 2025 ) assumes a uniform target and penalizes a rollout by the fraction of the group that shares its outcome. Because this fraction always counts the scored rollout among those sharing its outcome, it is a biased estimate of the model’s probability of that outcome. Distribution-aware reward ( Park et al., 2026 ) is designed for numeric regression and scores a group of predicted numbers against the correct number for each input. Its target is a single number, whereas ours is a probability distribution. Jang et al. (2026) list rewards scored over groups of samples as future work, but do not define or evaluate such a reward. Appendix A discusses further related work.
blocks.zh: 相关工作。 之前最接近我们的工作 也使用其他工作 来评分 对GAPO的奖励(Anschel等人,2025年)设定了一个统一的目标,并惩罚分享其成果的集团的一小部分推出. 因为这个分数总是在那些分享其结果的人中计算得分,所以对模型产生结果的概率有偏见的估计。 分布感赏(Park et al., 2026)是针对数值回归而设计的,并按每输入的正确数字对一组预测数字进行评分. 它的目标是一个数字,而我们的是一个概率分布。 张等. (2026) 榜单奖励得分超过样本组作为未来工作,但没有定义或评价这样的奖励. 附 录 讨论进一步的相关工作。

blocks.en: Error measure. We measure how far a distribution p p over outcomes is from the target q q with the total variation (TV) distance, TV ⁡ ( p , q ) = 1 2 ​ ∑ x | p ⁡ ( x ) − q ⁡ ( x ) | \mathrm{TV}(p,q)=\tfrac{1}{2}\sum_{x}|p(x)-q(x)| . TV is the largest difference between the probabilities that p p and q q assign to the same set of outcomes, and it ranges from 0 0 to 1 1 . We usually cannot compute the model’s outcome distribution exactly, so we estimate its TV from the empirical distribution of n n sampled outcomes (Section 4.1 ).

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: GRPO needs a reward for each rollout, but whether the model samples correctly depends on the group as a whole (Section 2 ). Section 3.1 derives such a reward, the witness advantage, from the maximum mean discrepancy. Section 3.2 shows that, in expectation, training with this advantage performs gradient descent on the distance to the target distribution. Section 3.3 shows that the group-scalar reward optimizes a biased objective and that the sign witness does not train outcomes with small target probability toward their targets.
blocks.zh: GPRO需要奖励每次推出,但模型样本是否正确取决于整个组别(第2节). 第3.1节从最大平均差异中获得这种奖励,即证人的优势。 第3.2节表明,预期具有这一优势的培训将在距离目标分布的距离上进行梯度下降。 第3.3节显示,集体奖励优化了偏颇的目标,标志证人不会将目标概率小的结果训练到目标上。

blocks.en: 3.1 The Witness Advantage
blocks.zh: 3.1 证人优势

blocks.en: To train a model to sample from a target distribution, we need a function that tells us, for each outcome, whether the model produces it too often or too rarely, and by how much. Given such a function, each rollout i i receives an advantage computed from the function’s value at its own outcome x i x_{i} . The advantage is positive if x i x_{i} is under-produced and negative if x i x_{i} is over-produced. Training then produces more of the under-produced and less of the over-produced outcomes, shifting the outcome distribution toward the target distribution. We also want this function to come from a distance between the model’s outcome distribution and the target, so that we can prove training reduces this distance. The maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) of Gretton et al. (2012) gives such a distance, together with a function of this kind, called the witness function.

blocks.en: 3.3 Where Simpler Rewards Fail
blocks.zh: 3.3 较简单 奖励失败

blocks.en: With the witness advantage, rollouts in the same group receive different advantages, because each advantage depends on the rollout’s outcome. We call this per-outcome credit . Its sign says whether the outcome is under- or over-produced, and its size grows with the mismatch. To test whether training needs advantages that vary across outcomes and reflect the size of the mismatch, we analyze two simpler rewards, each of which removes one of these properties.
blocks.zh: 由于证人的优势,同一群体的推出获得不同的优势,因为每个优势都取决于推出的结果. 我们称这为"每个结果的信用". 其标语表示结果是否产量不足或过多,其大小随不匹配而增长. 为了检验培训需要的优势是否因结果而异,并反映不匹配的大小,我们分析两个更简单的奖励,每个奖励都去掉了其中一个属性.

blocks.en: Group-scalar reward. The most direct way to reward a group for matching the target distribution is to score the group by − TV ⁡ ( p ^ , q ) -\mathrm{TV}(\hat{p},q) , where p ^ \hat{p} is the empirical distribution of its outcomes, and to give this score to every rollout in the group (Section 1 ). We call this the group-scalar reward . It gives GRPO no training signal, because every rollout in the group receives the same reward and subtracting the group mean leaves all advantages at zero (Lemma 4 , Appendix D ). To obtain a nonzero signal, we score several groups per prompt and subtract the mean score across groups. Specifically, we sample 256 256 rollouts for one prompt and split them into four subgroups of 64 64 . Every rollout receives the score of its subgroup minus the mean score of the four subgroups.
blocks.zh: 集团奖励. 最直接的奖励一组匹配目标分布的方法是用 – TV → (p , q ) -\ mathrm{TV} (\ hat{p}, q ) 给组分, 其中 p →\ hat{p} 是其成果的实证分布, 并且将这个分数给予组内每次推出(第 1 节) . 我们称这为集体奖励 它没有给GRPO任何训练信号,因为每一次在组内推出都得到同样的奖励,减去组别意味着所有优势都落在零(Lemma 4,附录D.). 为了获得非零信号,我们每个快速得分数组,并减去各组的平均分数。 具体地说,我们抽取了256 256次推出,一个即时推出,并将其分成四个分组,即64 64。 每次推出都得到其分组的分数减去四个分组的中间分数.

blocks.en: This repaired reward optimizes a biased objective. In expectation, training with it performs gradient descent on 𝔼 ⁡ [ TV ⁡ ( p ^ , q ) ] \mathbb{E}[\mathrm{TV}(\hat{p},q)] , the expected TV between the target and the empirical distribution of a group of G G draws from the model (Proposition 3 in Appendix D ). blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We first describe the targets, the metric, and the baselines (Section 4.1 ). We then train on synthetic distribution families, where the target is known exactly and we control which parameters and families the model sees in training (Section 4.2 ). On these targets, we compare the witness advantage with the baselines on the training targets, then test whether training transfers to unseen parameters and families, and then compare it with the two simpler rewards of Section 3.3 . Lastly, we test the witness advantage in two settings closer to real applications (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先描述了目标、衡量尺度和基线(第4.1节)。 然后,我们培训合成分销家庭,在那里,目标被确切了解,我们控制模型在培训中看到的参数和家庭(第4.2节)。 关于这些目标,我们将证人的优势与培训目标的基线进行比较,然后检验是否将培训转移到看不见的参数和家属,然后与第3.3节的两个更简单的奖励进行比较。 最后,我们在两个更接近实际应用的场合检验证人的优势(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: Targets. We use six families of discrete distributions from the Spectrum Suite ( Sorensen et al., 2026 ) : biased coin, binomial, geometric, Poisson, hypergeometric, and Zipf. Each family consists of 20 20 targets that differ in their parameters. The training set has 16 16 targets from each family except hypergeometric, 80 80 in all. The unseen parameters are the four remaining targets of each training family. The unseen families are 100 100 targets from five families not used in training: hypergeometric, number of empty boxes, discrete triangular, maximum of dice, and logarithmic series (Appendix F ). A model cannot know the possible outcomes of a family it has never seen, so the prompts for these targets list the valid outcomes.
blocks.zh: 目标 我们使用来自Spectrum Suite(Sorensen等人,2026年)的离散分布的六个家族:偏差硬币,二元币,几何,Poisson,超几何,Zipf. 每个家庭包括20个不同参数的目标。 这套培训每个家庭有16个目标,但超几何目标除外,总共80个。 看不见的参数是每个培训家庭剩下的四个目标。 无人知晓的家庭有100个目标,来自5个没有用于培训的家庭:超几何、空箱数、离散三角形、骰子最大值和对数系列(附录F)。 一个模型无法知道它从未见过的家庭的可能结果,因此这些目标的提示列出了有效的结果.

blocks.en: Metric. To evaluate a model on a target, we sample n n responses at temperature 1 1 , with n = 500 n=500 (up to 5,000 5{,}000 for unseen parameters), and compute the TV between q q and the empirical distribution p ^ n \hat{p}_{n} of the parsed outcomes. Unlike training (Section 2 ), evaluation leaves unparseable responses out of p ^ n \hat{p}_{n} and reports their rate separately.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 为了在目标上评估一个模型,我们在温度11时对nn的响应进行抽样,其中n=500n=500(为隐形参数最多5,000 5{,}000),并计算出q q与经验分布p ^ n\ hat{p}_{n}之间解析结果的TV. 与训练不同(第2节),评价从p^n\hat{p}_{n}中留下了无法解析的答复,并分别报告其比率。

blocks.en: Even a perfect sampler , one that draws exactly from q q , has positive TV between its empirical distribution and q q after any finite number of draws. This TV is larger for targets with more outcomes and for smaller n n , so raw TV values cannot be compared across targets. We therefore report excess TV , the measured TV minus the perfect sampler’s expected TV at the same n n , which we estimate by Monte Carlo. An excess TV of 0 0 means the model samples as well as a perfect sampler. We also measure general capabilities with MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) and IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) . For each benchmark, we compute a 95 % 95\% bootstrap confidence interval for the untrained model’s score. A trained score is within the noise band if it lies inside this interval.
blocks.zh: 甚至一个完美的采样者, 一个完全来自qq的采样者, 拥有正电视, 这台电视对于收效较多的目标, 因此我们报导了超量电视, 过量的0电视是指模型样本以及完美的采样机. 我们还用MMLU(Hendrycks等人,2021年)和IFEval(Zhou等人,2023年)来衡量一般能力。 对每个基准来说,我们计算出95 % 95 % 的靴子置信间隔来计算未受过训练的模型的得分。 一个训练有素的分数如果位于这个间隔内,就会在噪声带内.

blocks.en: Implementation details. All GRPO runs fine-tune Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct in TRL on one 48 GB GPU, with group size G = 64 G=64 , 256 256 rollouts per step, learning rate 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} , KL weight 0.02 0.02 , and temperature 1 1 . A main run on the synthetic distributions has 600 600 steps and takes about one GPU-hour (Appendix F.4 ).
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 GRPO在TRL运行微调Qwen2.5-1.5B-指令1台48GB GPU,组大小G=64 G=64,每步256个推出,学习率2×10−6 2\Times 10×6,KL重量0.02 0.02,温度1 1. 合成分布的主要运行有600,600步,并需要约1个GPU小时(Appendix F.4 .

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare against three kinds of baselines (details in Appendices F.4 and G.3 ). Simpler rewards replace only the reward, with the group-scalar reward or the sign witness of Section 3.3 . Supervised training minimizes the cross-entropy − ∑ x q ( x ) log π θ ( x ) -\sum_{x}q(x)\log\pi_{\theta}(x) to the stated PMF on the same targets ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Computing this loss requires the model’s probability of every outcome the target can produce. Training-free baselines change only the prompt or the decoding: verbalized sampling ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , seed conditioning applied only at inference ( Nagarajan et al., 2025 ) , renormalization onto the valid outcomes, and temperature scaling.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了三种基线(详见附录F.4和G.3)。 更简单的奖赏只代替奖赏,以团体奖励或第3.3节的标志性见证. 监督训练将交叉进球最小化 — — x x q( x) 对数 —\ sum_ x} q( x)\ log\\ pi\ seta} (x) 相同目标的PMF(Zhang等人, 2024) 。 计算这种损失需要模型对目标能够产生的每一种结果的概率。 无训练基线只改变即时或解码:口头抽样(Zhang等人,2026年),种子条件仅在推论时适用(Nagarajan等人,2025年),在有效结果上重新正常化,温度缩放。

blocks.en: 4.2 Results on Synthetic Distributions
blocks.zh: 4.2 合成分配结果

blocks.en: Table 1: On the 100 targets from five distribution families never seen in training, the witness advantage has the lowest median excess TV and keeps general capabilities. The oracle temperature is tuned on each target.
blocks.zh: 表1:在培训中从未见到的5个分发家庭的100个目标中,证人的优势是电视播放量中位数最低,并保持一般能力。 每个目标都有预言体温度

blocks.en: Training with the witness advantage makes the model sample much closer to the target distributions, on the training targets and on unseen parameters and unseen families (Table 4 in Appendix G ). On the five families never seen in training, it has the lowest error of all compared methods and keeps general capabilities (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 具有证人优势的培训使模型样本更接近目标分布、培训目标以及无形参数和无形家庭(附录G表4)。 在培训中从未见过的5个家庭中,它的错误是所有比较方法中最低的,并保持一般能力(表1)。

blocks.en: Witness advantage fits the training targets and keeps capability. Training removes 79 % 79\% of the excess TV on the non-Zipf training targets, from 0.477 0.477 to 0.101 0.101 . MMLU and IFEval stay inside their noise bands, and fewer than 1 % 1\% of responses are unparseable. The strongest baseline is supervised cross-entropy training on the target PMF. It fits the training targets better than the witness advantage, but it drops MMLU by 10 10 points and IFEval by 23 23 points relative to the untrained model. The witness advantage changes them by only 0.1 0.1 and 1.6 1.6 points. Most of the remaining error of the witness advantage is on binomial and Poisson targets, where the draws are far more spread out than the target (Appendix G.4 ).
blocks.zh: 证人的优势符合培训目标并保持能力。 培训取消了非Zipf培训目标的79%的多余电视,从0.477 0.477到0.101 0.101。 MMLU和IFEval留在它们的噪声带内,不到1%的1+Q的响应是无法解析的. 最强的基准是在目标PMF上监督的交叉接触训练. 它比目击优势更适合训练目标,但相对于未训练模式,它比MMLU降10分,IFEval降23分. 证人的优势只改变了0.1,0.1和1.61.6分. 证人优势的剩余误差大多在二元和普瓦松目标上,其中的抽图比目标(Appendix G.4 .

blocks.en: Training-free baselines start from wrong probabilities. We evaluate the training-free baselines on the unseen families (Tables 1 and 8 ). The best of them, an oracle temperature per target chosen with knowledge of q q , removes only 19 % 19\% of the excess TV. These baselines change only the prompt or the decoding, so they start from the untrained model’s probabilities over outcomes. These probabilities are wrong even though the model knows the target (Figure 1 b). For the 27 27 training targets with at most 12 12 outcomes, we compute the untrained model’s outcome distribution exactly from its log-probabilities. Its median TV to the target is 0.37 0.37 , so the error is present before any outcome is drawn and is not sampling noise. Training with the witness advantage lowers this exact TV to 0.09 0.09 . A decoding rule can only reshape the wrong probabilities. Temperature can only sharpen or flatten them, and renormalizing onto the valid outcomes does not help ( 0.600 0.600 against 0.589 0.589 ). Verbalized sampling also fails, because the probabilities the model writes out are as wrong as its draws, with a median TV of 0.71 0.71 per parsed list. Appendix G.3 gives the other baselines and the larger untrained models.
blocks.zh: 无培训基线是从错误的概率开始的。 我们评估在看不见的家庭中的无培训基线(表1和表8)。 其中最好的,每个选择的目标的甲骨文温度 了解qq, 仅删除19%的多余电视。 这些基线只改变即时或解码,所以它们从未经训练的模型对结果的概率开始。 这些概率是错误的,即使模型知道目标(图1b). 对于27个最多12个成果的培训目标,我们完全从其日志概率来计算未经培训的模式的成果分配。 它的电视到目标的中位数为0.37 0.37,因此在得出任何结果之前就存在错误,而不是取样噪音. 用证人的优势进行训练 使得电视机的收视率降到0.09 0.09 解码规则只能重塑错误的概率. 温度只能使其磨损或扁平,而恢复到有效结果上则无济于事(0.600 0.600对0.589) (原始内容存档于2018-05-29). 0.589. 口头抽样也失败了,因为模型写出的概率与其图纸一样错误,每解析列表的电视中位数为0.710.71. 附录G.3给出了其他基线和更大的未经培训的模型.

blocks.en: The improvement transfers to unseen parameters and families. Training removes 67 % 67\% of the excess TV on the 16 16 unseen-parameter targets outside Zipf, from 0.483 0.483 to 0.161 0.161 . Cross-entropy transfers better here ( 0.094 0.094 ), at the capability cost above.
blocks.zh: 改善向无形参数和家庭的转移。 在Zipf以外的16个不可见参数目标上,培训取消了67%的多余电视,从0.483 0483减少到0.161 0.161 (英语). 这里的跨线传输较好(0.094 0.094),其能力成本高于此.

blocks.en: The trained model also samples better from the five families it never saw in training, and removes 36 % 36\% of their excess TV (Table 1 ). Supervised cross-entropy was trained on the same prompts, so the comparison in the table is like for like. These training prompts, unlike the unseen-family prompts, do not list the valid outcomes. A retrain on prompts that list them still removes 24 % 24\% , more than the 19 % 19\% of the oracle temperature, and improves every unseen family (Appendix G ). Most of the improvement does not come from copying the listed outcomes. When we remove the list from the evaluation prompts, three quarters of the improvement remains (Appendix G.5 ).
blocks.zh: 训练有素的模特也从从未见过的5个家庭中抽取较好的样本,并移除了36%的多余电视(表1)。 被监督的交叉进球被训练在相同的提示上,所以表中的比较就像类似. 这些培训提示与未见的家庭提示不同,没有列出有效的结果。 在提示上重新排练,列出它们的提示仍然能消除24%的24+Q,超过甲骨文温度的19%的19+Q,并改进每一个看不见的家庭(附录G). 多数改进并非来自复制所列结果。 当我们从评价中删除清单时,四分之三的改进仍然存在(附录G.5)。

blocks.en: Training needs per-outcome credit of the right size.
blocks.zh: 培训需要适当规模的每个结果的功劳。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Median TV during training on (a) the 64 training targets outside the Zipf family and (b) the 16 Zipf targets, which have many low-mass outcomes. Outside Zipf, the sign witness trains as well as the witness advantage, and the group-scalar reward ends where the untrained model starts. On Zipf targets, only the witness advantage brings the TV close to zero.
blocks.zh: 图2:在培训期间的中线电视:(a) Zipf家庭以外的64个培训目标;(b) 16个 Zipf目标,这些目标有许多低质量成果。 在Zipf以外,标志证人列车以及证人的优势,团体-scalar奖励在未经训练的模型开始时结束. 在Zipf目标上,只有证人优势让电视接近0.

blocks.en: Section 3.3 shows that the group-scalar reward optimizes a biased objective, and predicts that the sign witness trains like the witness advantage except on low-mass outcomes. With the same data and compute, the group-scalar reward does not lower the median TV on the non-Zipf training targets. It ends at 0.55 0.55 , where the untrained model starts (Figure 2 a), although some families improve (Table 5 ). On unseen parameters, the witness advantage has lower TV than the group-scalar reward in each of three seeds (Table 6 ). On unseen families the two rewards are closer, and their intervals overlap at every group size in a sweep (Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 第3.3节显示,团体-scalar奖赏优化了一个偏颇的目标,并预测除了低质量的结果外,标志证人像证人的优势一样进行训练. 通过同样的数据和计算,团体-scalar奖励不会降低非齐普夫训练目标上的中位电视. 结束于0.55 0.55, 未受过训练的模型从那里开始(图2a),尽管有些家庭有所改善(表5)。 在看不见的参数上,目击者的优势比三个种子中每个种子的团体奖励低(表6)。 在未见的家庭中,两个奖赏更接近,其间隔在一次扫荡中与每个群体的规模重叠(表7)。

blocks.en: The sign witness trains as well as the witness advantage on every family except Zipf. Its final median TV on the non-Zipf training targets (Figure 2 a) is 0.151 0.151 , against 0.132 0.132 for the witness advantage. On 36 36 unseen targets outside Zipf, its paired difference from the witness advantage is indistinguishable from zero (Table 6 ). Zipf targets have many low-mass outcomes, those with target probability below 1 / ( G − 1 ) ≈ 0.016 1/(G-1)\approx 0.016 , which the sign witness does not train toward their targets (Proposition 2 (iii)). On the Zipf training targets, the median TV ends at 0.60 0.60 with the sign witness and at 0.10 0.10 with the witness advantage (Figure 2 b). The size of the credit is therefore needed for low-mass outcomes.
blocks.zh: 除了Zipf之外,标志证人对每个家庭都有好处。 它在非Zipf训练目标(图2a)上的最后中位电视为0.151 0.151,而证人的优势是0.132 0.32。 在Zipf以外的36个未见目标上,其与证人优势的对比差异与零无法区分(表6)。 Zipf目标具有许多低质量结果,目标概率低于1 /(G− 1) + 0.016 1/(G-1)\ 约 0.016 ,而标志性证人并不对其目标进行培训(建议2(三))。 在Zipf训练目标上,中位数电视结束为0.60 0.60与标志证人,0.100.10与证人优势(图2b). 因此,低质量的结果需要信贷的规模。

blocks.en: 4.3 Results on Tasks Closer to the Real World
blocks.zh: 4.3 更接近现实世界的任务成果

blocks.en: Figure 3: Training on stated opinion distributions and urn draws beats prompting and a larger model, and it transfers to a task never seen in training. Bars are median excess TV to the target distribution. (a, b) Test prompts of the two training tasks. (c) The NYTimes task, never seen in training. Best prompting is the better of verbalized sampling and in-context steering, which puts ten draws from the target in the prompt. Trained values are means over three seeds.
blocks.zh: 图3:关于公开意见分配和骨灰抽取的培训可催促和更大的模型,并转移到培训中从未见过的任务。 酒吧是目标发行量中位数的多余电视. (a、b) 测试两项培训任务的提示。 (c) 《纽约时报》的任务,在培训中从未见过。 最好的诱导方式是口头取样和内文指导,这把目标中的十个因素放在迅速。 训练的数值是指三种种子。

blocks.en: Along with synthetic distributions, we also test our method on tasks closer to the real world, namely opinion distributions and structured outputs, with the same error measure and training procedure. Appendix H gives the full setup and results.
blocks.zh: 除了合成分配之外,我们还试验我们的方法,以完成更接近现实世界的任务,即意见分配和结构化产出,同时采用同样的错误计量和培训程序。 附 录 H给出了完整的设置和结果.

blocks.en: Training transfers to test prompts and to an unseen task. Three tasks from the Spectrum Suite ( Sorensen et al., 2026 ) state a distribution over at most six answer options and ask for one draw. Urn draws state color proportions, GlobalOpinionQA ( Durmus et al., 2024 ) gives country-level answer distributions to opinion questions, and the NYTimes task gives book preferences by demographic group ( Meister et al., 2025 ) . We train on urn and GlobalOpinionQA prompts and evaluate on test prompts of both (Appendix H ), on the NYTimes task, never seen in training, and on an implicit variant of the test prompts. The implicit variant removes the stated probabilities, so the model must infer the distribution from the context, such as the balls in the urn or the respondent’s country.
blocks.zh: 培训转移用于测试提示和一项无形的任务。 Spectrum Suite(Sorensen等人,2026年)的三项任务,指出最多六个答案选项的分布,并要求一张图. Urn绘制了州色比例,GlobalOpinionQA(Durmus等人,2024年)给出了国家一级对观点问题的答案分布,NYTimes的任务给出了按人口组别分类的书籍偏好(Meister等人,2025年). 我们在骨灰盒和GlobalOpinionQA上进行训练,在测试提示上(附录H),在NYTimes任务上,在训练中从未见过,以及在测试提示的一个隐含变体上,进行提示和评估. 隐含的变体消除了所述的概率,因此模型必须从上下文推断分布,如骨灰盒中的球或被申请人的国家.

blocks.en: Training lowers the error on every evaluation set (Figure 3 and Table 10 ). Across three seeds, it removes 80 % 80\% to 92 % 92\% of the excess TV on urn and GlobalOpinionQA test prompts, 61 % 61\% to 72 % 72\% on the unseen NYTimes task, and 56 % 56\% to 69 % 69\% on the implicit variant. It also has lower excess TV than the best prompting method on every set of Figure 3 . On test prompts, the best temperature over { 0.7 , 1.0 , 1.3 , 1.5 } \{0.7,1.0,1.3,1.5\} reaches 0.25 0.25 on both tasks, against 0.04 0.04 and 0.03 0.03 after training. On every evaluation set, the trained 1.5B model is also closer to the stated distributions than the untrained Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. This training has a cost. MMLU falls by 2.1 2.1 points, outside its noise band, while IFEval stays inside its band.
blocks.zh: 培训降低了每套评价的错误(图3和表10)。 通过三种种子,它移除了骨灰盒和GlobalOpinionQA测试提示上80%的80\%到92%的多余电视,61%的61\%到72%的72\%到看不见的NYTimes任务,56%的56\%到69%的69\%到隐性变体. 它拥有比每套图3上最好的提示方法更低的多余电视. 在测试提示中,在 { 0.7, 1.0, 1.3, 1.5 } > 0.7, 1.0, 1.3, 1.5 } > 以上的最佳温度在两项任务上都达到 0.25 0.25, 而在训练后则为 0.04 0.04 和 0.03 0.03 . 在每套评价中,经过训练的1.5B模型也比未经过训练的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct更接近于说明的分布. 培训费用很高。 MMLU在它的噪声波段之外下降2.1 2.1分,而IFEval则留在它的波段内.

blocks.en: Training also improves structured outputs. A task adapted from sibling discovery ( Nagarajan et al., 2025 ) names a parent and its children and asks for one pair of siblings, so the model must build the valid pairs before sampling among them. On targets uniform over the pairs, training removes 35 % 35\% and 39 % 39\% of the excess TV in two seeds, compared with 5 % 5\% for the best decoding baseline. On targets that state a non-uniform probability for each pair, it removes 47 % 47\% (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 培训还改进了结构化产出。 一项由兄弟姐妹发现(Nagarajan等人,2025年)改编而成的任务给父母及其子女取名,要求一对兄弟姐妹,因此模型必须在他们中间采样之前建立有效对. 在目标对准上,培训取消了两个种子中35%的35%和39%的多余电视,而最佳解码基线为5%的5%。 在指出每对非统一概率的目标上,它去除47%的47\%(附录H).

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: We show that policy optimization, specifically GRPO, can reduce the mismatch between a language model’s stated and sampled distributions, but only when the training signal assigns credit at the level of individual outcomes. A scalar reward for an entire group is insufficient: under GRPO, it is eliminated by group-relative centering. We propose the witness advantage , which instead converts the group-level distribution mismatch into per-rollout credit, increasing under-produced outcomes and decreasing over-produced ones. Training with this credit substantially improves sampling on the synthetic training distributions, transfers to unseen parameters and families, and works on tasks closer to the real world, while largely preserving general capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,政策优化,特别是GRPO,可以减少语言模型所描述的分布和抽样分布之间的不匹配,但只有在培训信号在单个结果一级分配信用时才会如此。 整个团体的斯卡尔奖赏是不够的:在GRPO下,通过集团关系中心化来消除. 我们提出证人优势, 将集体分配不匹配 转换成每批贷款, 利用这种信贷进行的培训大大改进了合成培训分配的抽样,向无形参数和家庭转移,并致力于更接近现实世界的任务,同时在很大程度上保持了一般能力。

blocks.en: More broadly, our results suggest that group-defined objectives require more than a group-level score: they require a mechanism for attributing the group’s error to individual rollouts. We study this principle for finite outcome spaces, though the witness advantage can be defined for any kernel. An important next step is to apply it to free-form text, where a target distribution may be represented by example responses and a kernel can encode similarity between responses. This would extend distribution-matching post-training to settings in which the outcome space cannot be enumerated.
blocks.zh: 更广义地说,我们的结果表明,集团确定的目标需要的不仅仅是集团一级的分数:它们需要一种机制,将集团的错误归咎于个人的推出。 我们研究这一原则是为了有限的结果空间,尽管任何内核都可以确定证人的优势。 下一步的一个重要步骤是将其应用于自由格式文本,其中一个目标分布可能以实例响应来表示,一个内核可以编码反应之间的相似性. 这将将分配匹配的培训后推广到无法列举结果空间的场合。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en: Language models are poor random number generators ( Van Koevering & Kleinberg, 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and aligned models do worse than their base models at random number generation and mixed-strategy games ( West & Potts, 2025 ) . Jang et al. (2026) show that instruction-tuned models collapse to one answer when asked for a draw, that the collapse widens at every stage of post-training, and that the same models describe the target correctly in one call. Xiao et al. (2025) find the same mismatch between describing and sampling a Bernoulli distribution, and Meister et al. (2025) and Gu et al. (2026) find it on opinion distributions and in frontier models. One line of remedies acts at inference time. These methods prompt for a seed string before the draw ( Misaki & Akiba, 2026 ) , randomize surface features of the prompt across calls ( Jang et al., 2026 ) , or have the model accept or reject proposed draws in natural language, a verbalized form of rejection sampling ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) . Another line fine-tunes the model with a supervised loss. Zhang et al. (2024) minimize the cross-entropy between the model’s distribution over valid outputs and the target distribution, and our supervised baseline follows their objective (Appendix F.4 ). Baldelli et al. (2026) fine-tune on prompts that name a distribution family and its parameters. They train either on next-token probabilities computed from the target distribution or on completions sampled from it, and their models sample more accurately than the same models before fine-tuning on families and parameter settings not seen in training. Jang et al. (2026) name two training-time directions that their evidence calls for, a loss that matches a stated output distribution and rewards scored over groups of samples, and do not run them. We train with policy optimization and a reward of the second kind, and we show that training needs advantages that differ across outcomes and grow with the mismatch at each outcome (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 语言模型是劣质的随机数生成器(Van Koevering & Kleinberg, 2024; Zhang et al., 2024; Zhao et al., 2026),对齐模型在随机数生成和混合策略游戏(West & Potts, 2025)中比其基础模型更差. Jang等人(2026年)显示,指令调制的模型在要求绘制时会崩溃到一个答案,崩溃在训练后的每一阶段都会扩大,同样的模型在一个呼叫中正确描述了目标. Xiao等人(2025年)在描述和取样Bernoulli的分布和Meister等人(2025年)和Gu等人(2025年)之间发现了同样的不匹配。 (2026)在意见分布和前沿模型中找到. 一种补救方式在推断时间发生。 这些方法在抽取前即为种子字符串(Misaki & Akiba, 2026),随机抽取闪点的表面特征横调(Jang等人, 2026),或者让模型接受或拒绝以自然语言提出的抽取,一种口头化的拒绝采样(Xiao等人, 2025). 另一条线对模型进行了有监督损失的微调. Zhang等人(2024年)将模型在有效产出上的分布与目标分布之间的交叉交织最小化,我们所监督的基线遵循它们的目标(附录F.4 )。 Baldelli等人(2026年)对命名分布家族及其参数的提示进行了微调. 他们要么接受从目标分布中计算出的下一个概率的培训,要么接受从目标分布中取样的完成率的培训,他们的模型样本比同一模型更准确,然后再对培训中看不到的家庭和参数设置进行微调。 张等. (2026) 列出其证据要求的两个培训时间方向,这一损失与申报的产出分配和对样本的奖励相符,而不是运行样本。 我们进行政策优化和第二种奖励的培训,我们显示,培训需要不同结果的不同优势,并随着每项结果的不匹配而增长(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: Post-training reduces output diversity ( Kirk et al., 2024 ; Padmakumar & He, 2024 ; Murthy et al., 2025 ) , and language models produce homogeneous outputs ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Proposed causes include typicality bias in preference data ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and sharpening ( Gai et al., 2026 ) , the mechanism that Huang et al. (2025) study in self-improvement. Preference learning also implicitly aggregates the differing preferences of annotators ( Siththaranjan et al., 2024 ) . In reinforcement learning for reasoning, the collapse appears as falling entropy and pass@ k k ( Cui et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ) . Remedies restore diversity without a target ( He et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Nagarajan et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Springer et al., 2026 ) . Verbalized sampling ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) asks for several candidates with probabilities in one call. It is evaluated mainly on diversity and on distributions the model already holds, such as pretraining frequencies, and its only instructed target is a fair die. We evaluate against arbitrary PMFs stated in the prompt. A stated target must counteract collapse while preserving a specific distribution, so diversity restoration is not a substitute. A stated PMF can require less randomness as well as more, as for the coin of Figure 1 a.
blocks.zh: 培训后减少产出多样性 (Kirk等人, 2024年;Padmakumar & He, 2024年;Murthy等人, 2025年),语言模型产生同质产出. (蒋等,2025;张等,2025). 建议的原因包括偏好数据中的典型偏差(张等人,2026年)和锐化(Gai等人,2026年),黄等人在自我改进中研究的机制(2025年). 偏好学习也隐含地综合了注释者的不同偏好(Siththaranjan等人,2024年)。 在强化推理学习中,坍塌看起来是下降的 en和通过@kk(Cui等人,2025年;He等人,2025年)。 补救措施在没有目标的情况下恢复多样性(He等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年a;Nagarajan等人,2025年;Wu等人,2026年;Springer等人,2026年)。 口头抽样(Zhang等人,2026年)在一次征召中要几个有概率的候选人. 评估对象主要是多样性和模式已经具备的分布,如预训频率,其唯一的指示目标是公平死亡。 我们对照即时声明的任意性多指标类集基金进行评估。 既定目标必须防止崩溃,同时保持具体的分布,因此多样性的恢复不是替代。 与图1 a的硬币一样,说明的PMF可以要求更少的随机性以及更多的随机性。

blocks.en: GFlowNet fine-tuning ( Hu et al., 2024 ) and distributional control ( Khalifa et al., 2021 ) fine-tune a model toward a target density over sequences that the task defines through a reward or constraints, and twisted sequential Monte Carlo ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) samples from such a density at inference time. Distributional control can define the density through moment constraints, such as a stated fraction of outputs with some attribute. In all three methods the task defines the target, and the prompt does not state it as a PMF. DMPO ( Li et al., 2026b ) and FlowRL ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) match distributions induced by a scalar reward and have no access to a stated PMF. Several recent works make a rollout’s GRPO reward depend on its group, and ours is closest to them. GAPO ( Anschel et al., 2025 ) rewards each rollout by one minus the signed difference between the group frequency of its output and a uniform target over the valid options. For a uniform target, this reward is an affine function of the same signed deviation as our witness advantage, with two differences. Its reward is defined for a uniform target and takes no stated non-uniform PMF, and the frequency counts the rollout itself, the self-count that the leave-one-out frequency removes (Appendix C.1 ). Distribution-aware reward ( Park et al., 2026 ) scores a group of numeric rollouts with a proper scoring rule against a scalar label and pays each rollout its leave-one-out marginal contribution to the group score. Its target is one label and its credit is a difference of two group scores. Our target is a stated PMF and our credit is the witness in closed form. The closed form lets us prove unbiasedness and state what mean-centering does. On a binary alphabet, the property-ratio reward of Huang et al. (2026) equals the sign witness computed from the full group, up to centering and scale, on every group whose ratio lies outside their tolerance band, and their multi-class variant extends this correspondence to larger alphabets (Appendix E.5 ). Pass@ k k policy optimization ( Walder & Karkhanis, 2025 ) also turns an objective defined on a set of rollouts into per-rollout rewards. It derives unbiased estimators of pass@ k k and of its gradient, so its objective is the joint success of a set of rollouts and not a match to a distribution. Spectrum Tuning ( Sorensen et al., 2026 ) trains for distributional coverage by supervised fine-tuning on samples, and the pluralistic-alignment program ( Sorensen et al., 2024 ) names distributional calibration as a goal. GRPO’s policy gradient can be written as a U-statistic ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , the same form as the unbiased MMD estimator on which the witness advantage is built.
blocks.zh: GFlow 风速 净微调(Hu等人,2024年)和分布控制(Khalifa等人,2021年)将模型调整为目标密度,超越任务通过奖励或制约确定的序列,并扭曲了蒙特卡洛(Zhao等人,2024年)从这种密度推断时产生的样本的顺序。 分布式控制可以通过瞬间限制来定义密度,例如,表示有一定属性的产出的一小部分. 在所有三种方法中,任务都定义了目标,即时器并没有将其表述为PMF. DMPO(Li等人,2026年b)和FlowRL(Zhu等人,2026年)匹配了由悬赏诱导的分布,无法使用一个声明的PMF. 近期的几部作品让GRPO的奖励取决于其团体, GAPO(Anschel等人,2025年)奖励每次推出时,其输出的组频率与一个统一目标之间的签名差值以1减去有效选项. 对于一个统一的目标来说,这种奖赏是一种与我们证人的优势相同的签名偏差的附属函数,有两个不同之处. 它的奖励是针对一个统一目标而确定的,并且不采用说明的非统一性PMF,频率算上推出本身,即退出的频率去除的自我计算(附录C.1 ). 发行意识奖(Park et al., 2026)对一组数字滚出进行评分,对标标有适当的积分规则,每一次滚出一次对组分的积分为一出边际贡献. 它的目标是一个标签,它的信用是两个组分的差数. 我们的目标是一个公开的PMF 我们的信用是封闭式的证人 封闭的形式让我们能够证明不带偏见,并且说明罪恶中心的作用。 在二进制字母上,黄等人的财产-ratio奖励(2026年)等于从整个组中计算出的标志性见证,直到中心与规模,每个组的比例都处于其容忍带之外,他们的多级变体将这种对应性扩展到更大的字母(Appendix E.5 ). Pass@ kk 政策优化(Walder & Karkhanis, 2025)也将一组推出中定义的目标转化为每个推出的奖励. 它不带偏见地估算出通过@ k k 及其梯度,因此它的目标是一套推出的共同成功,而不是匹配分配。 Spectrum Tuning(Sorensen等人,2026年) 列车通过对样品进行监督的微调进行分布覆盖,多元调节方案(Sorensen等人,2024年) 命名分布校准作为目标. GRPO的政策梯度可以写成U统计学(Zhou et al.,2026),与证人优势所基于的无偏见的MMD估计器形式相同.

blocks.en: Appendices C , D , and E prove the results of Section 3 . This appendix collects what the three proofs share. We fix the notation, show that the proofs may work with outcomes in place of text responses, and state two lemmas about the score function that carry most of the algebra.
blocks.zh: 附录C、D和E证明第3节的结果。 此附录集此三证所共. 我们修补标记,显示证明可能与结果配合,以取代文本回复,并且说明两个关于记分函数的带大多数代数.

blocks.zh: B.1 标注

The two scores are different vectors, so a single update differs between the two views. Lemma 1 shows that the expected updates are equal whenever the weights depend on the responses only through their outcomes. Every advantage in this paper has this property, including the witness advantage and the sign witness before and after centering, and the group-scalar reward.

blocks.en: Lemma 1 says that when the weights depend only on outcomes, the expected update depends on the model only through its outcome distribution. The weights may be the advantages A i A_{i} or the centered advantages A ~ i \tilde{A}_{i} . With N = G N=G , the lemma covers the expected updates of Propositions 1 and 2 , before and after centering, including the update with the population sign in Proposition 2 (i). With N = K ​ G N=KG , it covers Proposition 3 (ii) in Appendix D . The proofs below therefore work with the outcome-level updates. The remaining claims, such as the standard-deviation bound of Proposition 3 (i) and the expected advantage of Proposition 2 (iii), concern the values of the advantages. These values are functions of the outcomes, so the claims hold in both views. The lemma is about expectations only. The response score also varies among responses with the same outcome, so the variance of an update differs between the two views.

N = K G N = KG ,它涵盖附录D中的提案3(ii). 因此,下文的证明与结果层面的最新情况有关。 其余的主张,如提案3(i)的标准减让约束和提案2(iii)的预期好处,都涉及优点的价值。 这些价值是结果的功能,因此索赔在两种观点中都有。 莱玛只是关于期望。 反应分数也因结果相同而不同,因此更新的差异在两种观点之间不同.

blocks.en: Appendix D Proofs for the Group-Scalar Reward
blocks.zh: 附录D 集团-斯卡拉尔奖励证明

blocks.en: Section 3.3 makes two claims about the group-scalar reward, which scores a group by the negative TV between its empirical distribution and the target and gives this score to every rollout. First, with one group per prompt it gives GRPO no training signal. Second, the repaired version, which scores several subgroups and subtracts their mean score, optimizes a biased objective. This appendix states both claims formally and proves them. It then simulates when the bias starts to matter.
blocks.zh: 第3.3节对团体-scalar奖项提出了两项主张,该奖项通过负面电视在经验发行与目标之间给一个团体打分,并将这一分数给予每次推出. 首先,每秒一个组,它不给GRPO任何训练信号. 第二,修复的版本,该版本分数为多个分组,并减去其平均分数,优化了一个偏颇的目标. 本附录正式陈述了两项索赔,并提供了证据。 然后模拟偏差开始重要的时候.

blocks.en: Let every rollout in a GRPO group receive the same reward. Then every advantage in that group is zero after the group mean is subtracted.

If every rollout receives the reward r 0 r_{0} , then every centered advantage is r 0 − r 0 = 0 r_{0}-r_{0}=0 . The update is therefore exactly zero on every batch. blocks.en: E.4 Simulating the Sign Witness on Zipf Targets
blocks.zh: E.4 在Zipf目标上模拟标志证人

blocks.en: The proof shows that the sign witness cannot hold low-mass outcomes with different target probabilities at their targets. It does not say whether their total probability ends too high or too low. We therefore simulate the replicator flow of the expected update, d d ​ t ​ log ⁡ π t ​ ( x ) = a ¯ ​ ( x ) − ∑ x ′ π t ​ ( x ′ ) ​ a ¯ ​ ( x ′ ) , \frac{d}{dt}\log\pi_{t}(x)=\bar{a}(x)-\sum_{x^{\prime}}\pi_{t}(x^{\prime})\,\bar{a}(x^{\prime}), which has the same stationary points. Here the subscript t t is time, and a ¯ \bar{a} is evaluated at π t \pi_{t} . We use G = 64 G=64 and three Zipf targets, with 200 200 outcomes and exponent 1.2 1.2 , 1,000 1{,}000 outcomes and exponent 1.5 1.5 , and 50 50 outcomes and exponent 2.0 2.0 . The flow starts from π 0 ​ ( x ) ∝ x − 2.5 \pi_{0}(x)\propto x^{-2.5} on the outcomes x = 1 , 2 , … x=1,2,\dots of the target. The sign flow raises the total probability of the low-mass outcomes to 1.5 1.5 to 2.4 2.4 times their target probability and stops at TV 0.13 0.13 to 0.47 0.47 from the target. blocks.en:
Huang et al. (2026) train with a per-group 0 / 1 0/1 reward that pushes the fraction of rollouts with a binary property toward a target ratio r t r_{t} (their notation). Let x i ∈ { 0 , 1 } x_{i}\in\{0,1\} be the property value of rollout i i , let r ^ \hat{r} be the group’s empirical ratio, and let ϵ ≥ 0 \epsilon\geq 0 be a tolerance. We assume that every rollout is valid, since they give invalid rollouts reward 0 0 and leave them out of r ^ \hat{r} . Their reward is R i = { x i if ​ r ^ < r t − ϵ , 1 − x i if ​ r ^ > r t + ϵ , 0 otherwise, R_{i}=\begin{cases}x_{i}&\text{if }\hat{r}<r_{t}-\epsilon,\\
1-x_{i}&\text{if }\hat{r}>r_{t}+\epsilon,\\
0&\text{otherwise,}\end{cases} and training stops once the ratio lies inside the band. Set q = Bernoulli ⁡ ( r t ) q=\mathrm{Bernoulli}(r_{t}) on { 0 , 1 } \{0,1\} . The sign witness computed from the full group is σ i = sign ⁡ ( q ⁡ ( x i ) − p ^ ​ ( x i ) ) = ( 2 ​ x i − 1 ) ​ sign ​ ( r t − r ^ ) , \sigma_{i}=\mathrm{sign}\big(q(x_{i})-\hat{p}(x_{i})\big)=(2x_{i}-1)\,\mathrm{sign}(r_{t}-\hat{r}), since q ⁡ ( 1 ) − p ^ ​ ( 1 ) = r t − r ^ q(1)-\hat{p}(1)=r_{t}-\hat{r} and q ⁡ ( 0 ) − p ^ ​ ( 0 ) = r ^ − r t q(0)-\hat{p}(0)=\hat{r}-r_{t} . On a group whose ratio lies outside the band, checking the two cases shows R i = ( 1 + σ i ) / 2 R_{i}=(1+\sigma_{i})/2 . Constants cancel under centering, so R i − R ¯ = ( σ i − σ ¯ ) / 2 R_{i}-\bar{R}=(\sigma_{i}-\bar{\sigma})/2 . If the group also contains both property values, both standard deviations are positive and the scale cancels too, so their standardized GRPO advantage equals the standardized sign witness. Inside the band, their reward is zero for every rollout, whereas σ i \sigma_{i} is nonzero unless r ^ = r t \hat{r}=r_{t} . Huang et al. (2026) also give a multi-class variant. It rewards rollouts from under-represented attributes with 1 1 and those from over-represented attributes with 0 0 , and removes the rollouts of attributes whose ratio lies inside the band. On a finite alphabet, this is the full-group sign witness shifted and scaled as above, restricted to outcomes outside the band. Their binary targets are r t = 0.5 r_{t}=0.5 and r t = 0.05 r_{t}=0.05 , with rollout sizes of 500 500 and 800 800 , so neither outcome is low-mass and the regime of part (iii) does not arise in their binary setting.

blocks.en: The parser is strict. It strips surrounding whitespace, one layer of matching quotes or backticks, and one trailing period, and the rest of the response must be exactly one outcome. For the biased coin, the outcome must be Heads or Tails, in any capitalization. For the integer families, it must be an integer inside the support of the target. Everything else maps to ⊥ \bot . The common cases are extra words (“The outcome is 3”), more than one outcome, a non-integer, and an integer outside the support, such as 0 0 for a geometric target or 9 9 for a binomial target with 8 8 trials. Training and evaluation use the same parser. In training, ⊥ \bot is an outcome with target probability 0 0 , so an invalid rollout receives the witness advantage − 2 ​ p ^ − i ​ ( ⊥ ) -2\hat{p}_{-i}(\bot) before centering, which is negative whenever another rollout of the group is also invalid. In evaluation, invalid responses are left out of the empirical distribution and their rate is reported separately.

blocks.en: For each training family, we take the candidate parameter settings that the Spectrum Suite code generates ( Sorensen et al., 2026 ) . We keep a candidate if a perfect sampler’s expected TV at 5,000 5{,}000 draws is at most 0.10 0.10 , estimated from 1,000 1{,}000 Monte Carlo replicates. This screen removes targets with more outcomes than a few thousand draws can resolve. From the kept candidates, we select 20 20 settings spaced by quantiles of the primary parameter, such as p p for the geometric family. We sort them by this parameter and number them from 0 0 . Ranks 2 2 , 7 7 , 12 12 , and 17 17 form the unseen-parameter set, and the other 16 16 are training targets. Each target is also assigned the smallest n ∈ { 500 , 2 , 000 , 5 , 000 } n\in\{500,2{,}000,5{,}000\} at which the perfect sampler’s expected TV is at most 0.10 0.10 . This n n is the number of evaluation draws for unseen-parameter targets (Appendix F.5 ). The five unseen families are screened the same way, with 20 20 targets each. Hypergeometric targets come from the Spectrum Suite code, and the other four families from our own samplers. In the rest of the appendix, we write occupancy for the number of empty boxes, triangular for the discrete triangular, and log-series for the logarithmic series.

blocks.en: Table 3 lists the settings shared by all GRPO runs. We follow Liu et al. (2025) in two choices. First, the loss normalizes by a constant length instead of each response’s length. Second, the advantages are centered by the group mean but not divided by the group’s standard deviation of rewards. The original GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) divides by this standard deviation. We do not, because the size of the witness advantage measures how far the model is from the target (Section 3.1 ), and dividing would remove this information and change the expected update derived in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 表3列出了所有 GRPO 运行所共享的设置. 我们跟随刘等人(2025年)两个选择. 首先,损失以固定长度而不是每次反应的长度正常化。 其二,优势以集团为中心,是指集团在奖励方面的标准偏差,但并不除以集团在奖励方面的标准偏差. 最初的GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)以这一标准偏差划分. 我们没有这样做,因为证人的优势大小衡量模型离目标有多远(第3.1节),而划分将删除这一信息,并改变附录C中预期的更新。
