blocks.en: This appendix adds detail to Section 4.2 . We give per-family results, the full comparison of the three rewards, the training-free baselines, a split of the remaining error, a test of whether the model relies on the listed outcomes, and a study of how transfer depends on the variety of training targets.
blocks.zh: 本附录补充了第4.2节的细节。 我们给出了每个家庭的成绩,三个奖励的完全比较,无训练基线,剩余错误的分拆,模型是否依赖于列出的结果的测试,以及转移如何取决于培训目标的种类的研究.

blocks.en: G.1 Results per Family
blocks.zh: G.1 每个家庭的成果

blocks.en: Table 4 reports all three synthetic evaluation sets for the untrained model, supervised cross-entropy, and the witness advantage. Table 5 gives the median excess TV per family, for the three rewards on the training families and for the two witness checkpoints on the unseen families. The witness advantage lowers excess TV on every training family, and its largest remaining errors are on Poisson and binomial targets (Appendix G.4 ). On the unseen families, the checkpoint trained on the original prompts improves four families and leaves occupancy about the same ( 0.615 0.615 to 0.623 0.623 ). The retrain on prompts in the evaluation format improves all five. Supervised cross-entropy, trained on the original prompts, removes 31 % 31\% of the excess TV on the unseen families, against 36 % 36\% for the witness advantage trained on the same prompts.
blocks.zh: 表4报告所有三套未经培训的模型的合成评价、监督的交叉接触以及证人的优势。 表5列出每个家庭、培训家庭的三个奖项和看不见家庭的两个证人检查站的中位数。 证人的优势降低了每个训练家庭的多余电视,其最大的剩余错误是针对Poisson和二元目标(Appendix G.4 . 在看不见的家庭中,经过原始提示培训的检查站改善了4个家庭,使占用率大致相同(0.615 0.615至0.623 0.623)。 在评价格式上对提示的再培训改善了所有五个。 监督的交叉竞技, 训练在原始的提示, 移除了31%的 31%的多余电视 在看不见的家庭,

blocks.en: Table 4: Sampling error on the three synthetic evaluation sets and general capabilities. Supervised cross-entropy fits the training targets and unseen parameters more closely than the witness advantage but loses 10 10 MMLU and 23 23 IFEval points. Sampling error is the median excess TV on the 64 training and 16 unseen-parameter targets outside the Zipf family and on the 100 unseen-family targets. Capability is accuracy, with 95% bootstrap half-widths of 0.008 0.008 (MMLU) and 0.033 0.033 (IFEval).
blocks.zh: 表4:三套合成评价的取样错误和一般能力。 监督的交叉进球比目击优势更符合训练目标和隐形参数,但损失10个MMLU和23个IFEval积分. 在Zipf家庭以外的64个培训和16个隐形参数目标以及100个隐形家庭目标上,抽样误差是中位数。 能力是准确的,95%的靴子半径为0.008 0.008(MMLU)和0.033 0.033(IFEval)。

blocks.en: Table 5: Median excess TV per family. Top: training families after 600 steps, with the lowest value per family in bold. Bottom: unseen families and all 100 unseen-family targets pooled, for the untrained model and for the witness advantage trained on the original prompts or on prompts in the evaluation format. All values use n = 500 n=500 draws per target. Figure 1 b uses the n n assigned to each target, so its untrained values differ from those in this table.
blocks.zh: 表5:每个家庭中超电视。 顶部:600步后培养家庭,每个家庭用粗体表示的价值最低. 底层:未见家庭和所有100个未见家庭目标汇集在一起,用于未经培训的模型和证人优势,按照最初的提示或评价格式接受过培训。 所有值使用n=500n=500抽取每个目标. 图1b使用分配给每个目标的nn,因此其未经训练的值与本表中的值不同.

blocks.en: G.2 Comparing the Three Rewards
blocks.zh: G.2 比较三项奖励

blocks.en: Table 6 gives the paired comparisons on unseen targets behind Section 4.2 . The witness advantage beats the group-scalar reward on unseen parameters in each of three seeds. The sign witness is indistinguishable from the witness advantage on 36 36 unseen targets outside the Zipf family. These are the 16 16 unseen-parameter targets of the other four training families and the 20 20 hypergeometric targets, evaluated with prompts in the original format. On the Zipf training targets the two differ (Figure 2 b).
blocks.zh: 表6提供了第4.2节后面未见目标的对等比较。 见证优势在3个种子的每个未见参数上胜过团体-scalar奖励. 标记证人与证人优势分不开 在36个隐形目标 在Zipf家族之外 这些是其他四个培训家庭的16个未见参数指标和20个超几何指标,以原始格式的提示评估。 关于Zipf培训目标,两者不同(图2b)。

blocks.en: Table 6: Paired per-target differences in TV on unseen targets outside the Zipf family. The top block uses the 16 16 unseen-parameter targets, and the bottom block adds 20 20 hypergeometric targets. Each difference is the TV of the second method minus the TV of the first, so a positive value favors the first. The superscript gives the larger side of the 95% bootstrap interval.
blocks.zh: 表6:Zipf家族以外未见目标电视的每个目标差异。 顶部块采用16个隐形参数目标,底部块增加了20个超几何目标. 每一种区别都是第二种方法的电视减第一种方法的电视,所以正面的数值有利于第一种方法. 上标给出了95%的靴子间隔的较大一面.

blocks.en: On the unseen families, the witness advantage and the group-scalar reward are closer. Table 7 varies the group size at a fixed 256 256 rollouts per step, and the intervals of the two rewards overlap at every group size. Two further sets of witness runs have no group-scalar counterpart. At G = 256 G=256 , the witness advantage removes 31.1 % 31.1\% of the excess TV (interval [ 22.1 , 40.6 ] [22.1,40.6] ). A second seed at G = 8 G=8 , 16 16 , 32 32 , and 128 128 removes 38.2 % 38.2\% , 40.3 % 40.3\% , 36.9 % 36.9\% , and 32.0 % 32.0\% .
blocks.zh: 在看不见的家属中,见证的好处和团体的奖励是更接近的。 表7按每步固定256 256次推出时不同组别,两个奖励的间隔在每个组别上重叠. 另有两组证人没有集体集会的对口单位。 在G=256 G=256时,目击优势清除了多余的电视机的31.1%的31.1\%(中间[22.1,40.6][22.1,40.6]). G=8 G=8,16,3232,128的第二种子清除了38.2%的38.2\%,40.3%的40.3\%,36.9%的36.9\%,32.0%的32.0\%.

blocks.en: Table 7: Group-size sweep with 256 rollouts per step, seed 0. Each entry is the reduction in excess TV on the 100 unseen-family targets, in percent, and the superscript gives the larger side of the 95% paired bootstrap interval. All runs were trained on the original prompts and evaluated on the unseen-family prompts, so they compare with the 36 % 36\% of the main run, not with the 24 % 24\% of the retrain on the evaluation format. The G = 64 G=64 witness run is separate from the main run.
blocks.zh: 表7:每步256个种子的分组扫描 零点 每个条目都是在100个隐形家庭目标上减少多余的电视, 以百分比表示,上标给出了95%对齐的靴子间隔中更大的一面。 所有跑步都经过了原始提示的培训,并且被评价为隐形家庭提示,因此它们与主跑步的36%的36\%相比,而不是与评价格式的24%的24\%再训练相比. G=64 G=64目击跑与主跑分开.

blocks.en: Rewarding diversity without reference to the target makes sampling worse than no training. Outside the Zipf family, the entropy-bonus run (Appendix F.4 ) reaches a median excess TV of 0.663 0.663 on the training targets, against 0.477 0.477 for the untrained model, and 0.730 0.730 on the unseen parameters, against 0.483 0.483 .
blocks.zh: 在不提及目标的情况下奖励多样性,使采样比没有培训更糟糕。 在Zipf家族之外,Entropy-bonus运行(Appendix F.4 )在训练目标上达到0.663 0.663的中超电视,而未训练型号为0.477 0.477,在未训练型号上则为0.730 0.730,而在未见参数上则为0.483 0 483.

blocks.en: G.3 Training-Free Baselines
blocks.zh: G.3 免费培训基线

blocks.en: Table 8 compares the training-free baselines of Section 4.2 on the unseen families. None of them removes more than 19 % 19\% of the excess TV, against 36 % 36\% for training with the witness advantage. All settings use the untrained Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and 500 500 draws per target unless stated otherwise. Settings that apply a method on top of the witness-trained model use a reproduction of the main run, trained with the same recipe. It reaches a pooled excess TV of 0.380 0.380 , against 0.376 0.376 for the main run, and their paired per-target difference is indistinguishable from zero (interval [ − 0.002 , 0.002 ] [-0.002,0.002] ).
blocks.zh: 表8比较了第4.2节关于隐形家庭的无培训基线。 超过19%的多余电视被删除,而36%的电视被删除,接受证人培训。 除非另有说明,所有设置都使用未经训练的Quen2.5-1.5B-指令和每个目标500500图. 在证人训练的模型之上应用某种方法的设置,使用复制主运行,用相同的食谱训练. 它达到了0.380 0.380 的集合过剩电视,而主跑0.376 0.376,它们成对的每个目标差与零(中间[− 0.002, 0.002] [-002, 0.02].

blocks.en: Table 8: Training-free methods on the 100 unseen-family targets, applied to the untrained Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, whose median excess TV is 0.589 0.589 . Reduction is relative to the untrained model. Both temperatures are chosen with knowledge of the targets.
blocks.zh: 表8:适用于未受过训练的Quen2.5-1.5B-指令的100个 " 看不见的家庭 " 目标的免费培训方法,其电视播放量中位数为0.589 0.589 (英语). 相对未经过培训的模型而言,减少。 在选择这两种温度时都了解目标。

blocks.en: Verbalized sampling ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) asks the model to list outcomes with probabilities and samples from the parsed list. Our prompt asks for five outcomes with probabilities. We parse the list with the same parser, renormalize it, and draw 500 500 outcomes from it. With one list per target, most lists do not parse. The published prompt, a variant that also names the support, and the published XML form give pooled excess TV between 0.945 0.945 and 0.959 0.959 , with a parse rate of 0.05 0.05 to 0.45 0.45 . With the published prompt, 46 46 of 100 100 targets yield lists whose probabilities are all zero, and 14 14 more list only outcomes outside the support.
blocks.zh: 虚化采样(Zhang等人,2026年)要求模型从解析清单中列出有概率的结果和样本. 我们迅速要求有五种可能性的结果。 我们用相同的解析器来解析列表,使其重新正常化,并从中提取500500个结果. 每个目标有一个列表,大多数列表不解析. 公布的即时报,一种同时命名支持的变体,以及公布的XML形式,使集合的多余的TV在0.945 0.945至0.959 0.459之间,解析率为0.05 0.05至0.45 0.45 0.45. 随着公布的迅速性,100个目标中有46个的产量清单,其概率均为零,还有14个只列出支助之外的结果。

blocks.en: Table 8 reports the best case, which pools ten verbalizations at temperature 1 1 with the support-naming prompt ( 0.518 0.518 ). At least one of the ten lists parses on every target. Even the lists that parse are wrong. Their median TV to the target is 0.71 0.71 , and 0.78 0.78 for greedy lists. Applied on top of the witness-trained model, verbalized sampling is equally poor ( 0.957 0.957 with the support-naming prompt). Zhang et al. (2026) evaluate verbalized sampling on frontier API models and on open models with 70B parameters or more, and report that its gains grow with model scale, so our results describe it only at 1.5B.
blocks.zh: 表8报告了最佳案例,在温度1 1 时将10个口语拼接在一起,并加上支持命名的速率(0.518 0.518 )。 十个名单中至少有一个对每个目标进行了描述。 连分析清单都错了 他们的电视中位数为0.71 0.71,而贪婪的名单为0.78 0.78。 在经过证人培训的模型上,口语抽样同样很差(0.957 0.957加上支持命名的提示)。 Zhang等人(2026年)评价了前沿API模型和70B参数或以上的开放模型的口头采样,并报告说其收益随模型尺度而增长,因此我们的结果只将其描述为1.5B.

blocks.en: Seed conditioning ( Nagarajan et al., 2025 ) trains and tests with a random string at the start of the prompt. We add such a string at inference only, here with 16 16 characters. With greedy decoding, three seed formats, one of them with 64 64 characters, give an excess TV of 0.834 0.834 to 0.847 0.847 , against 0.904 0.904 for greedy decoding without a seed, and a median of two to four distinct outcomes per target. At temperature 1 1 , the seeded prompt reaches 0.546 0.546 and the same prompt with a constant seed reaches 0.542 0.542 (paired difference 0.0001 0.0001 , interval [ − 0.003 , 0.005 ] [-0.003,0.005] ), so the randomness of the seed contributes nothing. Nagarajan et al. (2025) add seeds during both training and sampling, and we test only the sampling part.
blocks.zh: 种子调制(Nagarajan et al., 2025) 列车和测试,在提示的起始处使用随机弦. 我们只用推论加上这样的字符串,这里有16个字符. 以贪婪的解码法,三种种子格式,其中一种有64个64字符,给出的TV过量为0.834 0.834至0.847 0.847,而贪婪的解码没有种子则有0.904 0.904,每个目标有2到4个不同结果的中位数. 在气温1 1 时,播种的速率达到 0.546 0.546,同一速率与恒定种子的速率达到 0.542 0.542(paired difference 0.0001 0.0001,间隔[−0.003,0.005] [0.003,0.005]),因此种子的随机性无济于事. Nagarajan等人(2025年)在训练和取样过程中都添加种子,我们只测试取样部分.

blocks.en: Renormalization sets the probability of every invalid outcome to zero and rescales the rest to sum to one. Applied to the model’s sequence-level probabilities over the valid outcomes, it gives 0.600 0.600 (paired difference from plain sampling + 0.007 +0.007 , interval [ 0.002 , 0.013 ] [0.002,0.013] ). Taking the most likely valid outcome gives 0.903 0.903 . Editing the logits of a single token is possible on only 29 29 of the 100 100 targets, where it reaches 0.725 0.725 . On top of the witness-trained model, renormalization changes little ( 0.373 0.373 against 0.380 0.380 ).
blocks.zh: 恢复正常化将每个无效结果的概率设定为零,并将其余结果调整为总和为一. 适用于模型相对于有效结果的序列级概率,它给出了0.600 0.600(与普通采样+0.007+0.007,间隔[0.002,0.013] [0.002,0.013]的差值). 最可能有效的结果为0.903 0.903。 在100个指标中,只有29个指标能够编辑一个符号的对数,达到0.725 0.725。 在经过证人训练的模型之外,恢复正常化变化不大(0.373 0.373对0.380 0.380)。

blocks.en: A temperature chosen for each target to minimize the exact TV to q q gives 0.478 0.478 . The single best temperature for all targets, 2.76 2.76 , gives 0.514 0.514 . Both are tuned with knowledge of the targets, so they bound what temperature scaling can do. Replacing the model’s distribution by q q itself gives 0.001 0.001 , the excess TV of a perfect sampler, which is zero up to Monte Carlo error. On the 64 64 training targets outside the Zipf family and the 36 36 unseen targets of Table 6 , temperatures 1.3 1.3 and 1.5 1.5 reduce the excess TV by at most 9.5 % 9.5\% on the training targets and 6.5 % 6.5\% on the 36 36 unseen targets, and min- p p sampling and an explicit instruction to sample at random increase it.
blocks.zh: 为每个目标选择的温度将准确的电视机最小化为q q,得到0.478 0.478。 所有目标的最高温度2.76 2.76 给出0.514 0.514 两者都与目标的知识相适应,因此它们决定温度缩放能做什么. 以q q本身取代模型的发行量给0.0010.001,一个完美的采样器的多余的电视,这在蒙特卡洛错误面前是0。 在Zipf家庭以外的64个培训目标和表6的36个未见目标中,温度1.31.3和1.51.5将多余的电视在培训目标上减少最多9.5%,在36个未见目标上减少6.5%6.5%,并明确指示随机抽样。

blocks.en: Scaling the untrained model does not help. On the unseen families, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2024 ) , Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) all have a higher median excess TV than the 1.5B model, 0.63 0.63 to 0.72 0.72 against 0.59 0.59 (Figure 1 c).
blocks.zh: 扩大未经过训练的模型没有用。 在看不见的家庭中,Qun2.5-3B-指示,Qun2.5-7B-指示(Quen等人,2024年),Llama-3.2-3B-指示,Llama-3.1-8B-指示(Grattafiori等人,2024年)的电视播放量均高于1.5B型,0.63 0.63至0.72 0.79(图1c)。

blocks.en: G.4 Where the Remaining Error Is
blocks.zh: G.4 剩余错误在哪里

blocks.en: Figure 4 reports two diagnostics. Panel (a) checks part (i) of Proposition 3 in training. Panel (b) splits the remaining error of the witness advantage on its two hardest families.
blocks.zh: 图4报告了两项诊断。 (a) 小组检查第3号提案(一)部分的培训情况。 小组(b) 将证人优势的其余错误分为两个最困难的家庭。

blocks.en: Figure 4: (a) Standard deviation of the rewards in a batch, averaged over training, on a log scale. For the group-scalar reward, it equals the standard deviation of the advantages, and it lies below the ceiling of Proposition 3 (i) (vertical line). (b) TV on binomial and Poisson training targets, split into a coverage term (dark) and a shape term (light), for the untrained model and after training with the witness advantage. Each bar stacks the medians of the two terms over four targets, so its total can differ from the median TV. Training mainly reduces the coverage term.
blocks.zh: 图4:(a) 分批对奖励进行标准偏差,平均比照培训,按对数计算。 对于团体-scalar奖励,它等于优势的标准偏差,它位于建议3(i)(垂直线)的上限以下. (b) 关于二元和普瓦松训练目标的电视,分为覆盖(黑暗)和形状(光)两个用语,用于未受过训练的模型,并在培训后利用证人的优势。 每个巴将两个术语的中位数堆在四个目标上,因此其总和可以与中位数电视不同. 培训主要减少覆盖面。

blocks.en: For each run we log the standard deviation of the 256 256 rewards in a batch and average it over the 600 600 steps. It is 0.031 0.031 for the group-scalar reward, 0.140 0.140 for the witness advantage, and 0.847 0.847 for the sign witness. For the group-scalar reward, all rewards in a batch come from one prompt and differ from the advantages by a constant, so 0.031 0.031 is also the spread of its advantages. It lies below the ceiling 3 / 4 / ( 2 ​ 64 ) = 0.054 \sqrt{3/4}/(2\sqrt{64})=0.054 of Proposition 3 (i). For the other two rewards, a batch contains four prompts and GRPO subtracts a separate mean for each, so their logged spread also includes differences between prompts. The group-scalar reward gives at most four distinct advantages per batch, whereas the witness advantage can give 256 256 .
blocks.zh: 每次运行时,我们记录256 256次奖励的标准差值,平均超过600 600步。 团牌奖励为0.0310.031,证人优势为0.1400.140,签名证人为0.8470.847. 对于团体-scalar奖励,一个批次中的所有奖励都来自一个即时,以一个常数与优势不同,所以0.031 0.031也是其优势的传播. 它位于提案3(i)的上限3 / 4 / (2 64) = 0.054\sqrt{3/4}/(2\sqrt{64}) = 0.054。 对于另外两个奖励,一个批次包含4个提示符,GRPO减去每个提示符一个单独的平均值,因此其记录的分布还包括提示符之间的区别. 团体奖励每批最多给予四个不同的优势,而证人的优势是256 256。

blocks.en: On binomial and Poisson targets, the untrained model puts much of its probability on outcomes that the target almost never produces. To separate this error from errors in the relative probabilities, we split the outcomes of each target into its bulk, the interval [ F − 1 ​ ( 10 − 4 ) , F − 1 ​ ( 1 − 10 − 4 ) ] [F^{-1}(10^{-4}),F^{-1}(1-10^{-4})] , where F F is the target’s cumulative distribution function, and the rest. The TV then splits exactly into two terms. The coverage term is half the absolute error on produced outcomes outside the bulk plus half the target probability of the outcomes the model never produced. The shape term is half the absolute error on produced outcomes inside the bulk. We compute both from 500 500 draws on the four binomial and four Poisson training targets with the highest excess TV after training.
blocks.zh: 在二元和普瓦松目标上,未经过训练的模型将很多概率放在目标几乎从未产生的结果上. 为了将这一错误与相对概率的错误区分开来,我们把每个目标的结果分成一个大块,即间隔[F− 1(10− 4),F− 1(1− 10− 4] [F^{-1}(10^{-4}),F^{-1}(1-10^{-4})],其中FFF是目标累计分配功能,其余部分. 电视随后完全分为两个学期. 覆盖范围是大宗产品以外生产结果绝对误差的一半,加上模型从未产生结果的目标概率的一半。 形状术语是批量生产结果上绝对错误的一半。 我们计算出500人 从四个二进制和四个普瓦森训练目标中抽取了 训练后收视率最高的电视

blocks.en: Before training, most of the error is coverage. On binomial targets the untrained model’s median TV is 0.87 0.87 , and the median share of coverage is 71 % 71\% . On Poisson targets the median TV is 0.98 0.98 , and the median share of coverage is 98 % 98\% , with a sample mean a tenth of the target mean. Training with the witness advantage lowers the coverage term from 0.65 0.65 to 0.18 0.18 on binomial targets and from 0.95 0.95 to 0.57 0.57 on Poisson targets, and raises the ratio of the Poisson sample mean to the target mean from 0.10 0.10 to 0.51 0.51 . After training, the shape terms are 0.29 0.29 and 0.21 0.21 . The remaining binomial error is therefore mostly shape, while most of the remaining Poisson error is still coverage. On both families the draws are much more spread out than the target. The median ratio of the standard deviation of the draws to that of the target is between 7 7 and 15 15 , before and after training.
blocks.zh: 在训练前,大部分错误是覆盖. 在二元目标上,未受过训练的模型的中位数电视为0.87 0.87,中位数覆盖率为71% 71% 。 在Poisson目标上,电视的中位数为0.98 0.98,覆盖率的中位数为98% 98%%,抽样平均值为目标平均值的十分之一。 具有证人优势的训练将二元目标覆盖率从0.65 0.65降至0.18 0.18,波士逊目标覆盖率从0.95 0.95降至0.57 057,并将波士逊样本平均值与目标平均值的比例从0.10 0.10提高到0.51 0.51。 经过训练,形状术语为0.290.29和0.210.21. 剩下的二元误差因此大多是形状,而剩下的大部分普瓦松误差仍然被覆盖. 在两个家庭中,抽水比目标分布要广得多。 抽取物的标准偏差与目标偏差的中位比在训练前后的7至15 15之间.

blocks.en: G.5 Copying the Listed Outcomes
blocks.zh: G.5 复制所列结果

blocks.en: Every unseen-family prompt names the valid outcomes. A model could lower its excess TV by copying this list without reading the rest of the prompt. We first explain why the prompts list the outcomes. We then remove the list at evaluation and find that most of the improvement remains.
blocks.zh: 每个不见家庭的提示 都指名道姓 一个模型可以通过复制这份列表来降低其多余的电视机,而不阅读其余的提示. 我们首先解释为什么提示会列出结果。 然后,我们在评估时删除清单,发现大多数改进仍然存在。

blocks.en: Before we fixed the unseen-family prompts, we evaluated the witness checkpoint on the 20 20 hypergeometric targets in the original format, whose prompts do not name the valid outcomes. Training moved excess TV only from 0.625 0.625 to 0.614 0.614 , and the fraction of valid outputs fell from 0.64 0.64 to 0.40 0.40 . When few items are drawn, the support is tiny. When one item is drawn, it is { 0 , 1 } \{0,1\} , and the model emits counts far above it. A model cannot know the support of a family it has never seen, so the unseen-family prompts name it.
blocks.zh: 在我们确定隐形家庭的提示之前,我们用原始格式评价了20个超几何指标上的证人检查点,其提示没有列出有效的结果。 训练只把多余的电视从0.625 0.625移到0.614 0.614,有效产出的比例从0.64 0.64下降到0.40 0.40。 当绘制的项目很少时,支持是很小的。 当绘制一个项目时,它是{0, 1} {0, 1}} {0, 1}} , 而模型释放的计数远高于它 。 一个模型不可能知道一个从未见过的家庭的支持,因此,看不见的家庭会起名字。

blocks.en: We evaluate the untrained and the trained model with and without the sentence that names the valid outcomes, on all 100 100 unseen-family targets. The trained model is the reproduction of Appendix G.3 . Training improves excess TV by a median of 0.176 0.176 per target (interval [ 0.124 , 0.227 ] [0.124,0.227] ) with the sentence and 0.135 0.135 ( [ 0.120 , 0.173 ] [0.120,0.173] ) without it, so 77 % 77\% of the median improvement remains when the list is removed. The median per-target difference between the two improvements is 0.057 0.057 ( [ 0.010 , 0.103 ] [0.010,0.103] ), so the list contributes, but most of the improvement does not depend on it.
blocks.zh: 我们对所有100个无名氏家庭目标进行评估,评价未经训练和训练有素的模型,无论是否判给有效结果。 训练有素的模式是复制附录G.3. 训练使多余的电视机增加了0.1760.176的中位数,每个目标(中间[0.124,0.227] [0.124,0.227]),加上句子,没有它,则增加了0.1350.135([0.120,0.173] [0.120,0.173]),因此,在删除列表时,77%的中位数改进仍然保留. 两个改进的每个目标中位数差为0.0570.057([0.010,0.103][0.010,0.103]),因此列表有贡献,但大部分改进并不取决于它.

blocks.en: On log-series, a large improvement remains without the sentence, 0.226 0.226 ( [ 0.204 , 0.247 ] [0.204,0.247] ). On occupancy, the improvement is larger without the sentence (difference − 0.054 -0.054 , interval excluding zero). Removing the sentence also changes the prompt format, so this test does not separate the content of the list from the change of format.
blocks.zh: 在对数系列上,没有句子的大改进仍然是0.226 0.226([0.204,0.247] [0.204,0.247]). 入住时,没有句子的改善幅度较大(差数−0.054-0.054-0.54,间隔排除0). 删除句子也会改变即时格式,因此这个测试不会将列表的内容与格式的改变分开.

blocks.en: G.6 Variety of the Training Targets
blocks.zh: G.6 培训目标的多样性

blocks.en: Transfer to unseen families may depend on how varied the training targets are. To test this at matched compute ( 600 600 steps, same group size and decoding), we compare the five-family retrain with the witness advantage trained on three other training sets, all in the evaluation format. One has a single family (the 16 16 geometric targets), one a single target (a geometric target with p = 0.551 p=0.551 ), and one fifteen families ( 240 240 targets). Table 9 gives the results.
blocks.zh: 向看不见的家庭转移可能取决于培训目标的多样性。 为了在匹配的计算(600 600 步,同组大小和编解码)中测试这一点,我们比较了5个家庭的再培训与另外3个培训组培训的证人优势,所有培训均采用评价格式。 一个家庭(16个16个几何目标),一个家庭(一个几何目标,p=0.551 p=0.551),一个家庭(240 240个目标). 表9列出了结果。

blocks.en: Table 9: Median excess TV on the 100 unseen-family targets after training on sets of different variety, all with prompts in the evaluation format and the same compute. Reduction is relative to the untrained model ( 0.589 0.589 ).
blocks.zh: 表9:经过不同种类的成套培训后,100个未见家庭目标的中度超标电视,所有节目都有评价格式的提示和相同的计算。 与未受过训练的型号(0.589 0.589 )相比,减少。

blocks.en: Widening from five to fifteen families lowers excess TV on the typical target (median paired difference − 0.038 -0.038 , interval [ − 0.045 , − 0.025 ] [-0.045,-0.025] ).

The single-target run reaches about the same pooled value as the fifteen-family run, 0.397 0.397 against 0.394 0.394 , and a second seed of the single-target run reaches 0.383 0.383 . Its gains are narrow, however. Most come from log-series, the one unseen family that shares the geometric family’s support and decreasing shape (excess TV from 0.606 0.606 to 0.119 0.119 ), and from occupancy ( 0.615 0.615 to 0.456 0.456 ). On hypergeometric and maximum-of-dice targets it ends worse than the untrained model ( 0.654 0.654 to 0.693 0.693 and 0.662 0.662 to 0.701 0.701 ), while the five-family run improves every unseen family. The single-target model also does not read the stated parameter. On unseen geometric parameters, the single-family model has excess TV 0.02 0.02 to 0.11 0.11 for p p from 0.155 0.155 to 0.914 0.914 , while the single-target model is accurate only near its training value and reaches 0.44 0.44 at p = 0.155 p=0.155 .
blocks.zh: 单目标跑的集合值与15个家庭跑的集合值大致相同,0.397 0.397对0.394 0.394,单目标跑的第二种子达到0.383 0.383. 然而,其收益是有限的。 大部分来自日志系列,即一个与几何家族有共同支持和缩小形状的无名家庭(电视播放量从0.606 0.606到0.119 0.19),以及从占用(0.615 0.615到0.456 0456). 在超几何和最大水分目标上,它最终比未经训练的模型(0.654 0.654 至 0.693 0.693 和 0.662 0.662 至 0.701 0.701 )更糟糕,而五个家庭的运行改善了每一个看不见的家庭。 单目标模型也不读取所声明的参数. 在不可见的几何参数上,单家模型的p值从0.150.155到0.9140.914的TV 0.02 0.02到0.110.11,单家模型的精确度仅接近其训练值,在p=0.155 p=0.155时达到0.44 0.44.

blocks.en: Because compute is matched, fewer training targets also mean more visits to each prompt ( 2,400 2{,}400 group visits for the single target against 10 10 per target for fifteen families), so variety and repetition change together in this comparison.
blocks.zh: 由于计算是匹配的,培训目标较少也意味着每次快速访问的次数增加(2 400 2{,}对单一目标进行400次集体访问,对15个家庭进行每目标10次访问),因此在这种比较中,多样性和重复性的变化。

blocks.en: Appendix H Opinion Distributions and Structured Outputs
blocks.zh: 附录H 意见分配和结构化产出

blocks.en: This appendix gives the details of Section 4.3 . Table 10 lists the results on both tasks.
blocks.zh: 本附录详细介绍了第4.3节。 表10列出了这两项任务的结果。

blocks.en: Table 10: Stated opinion distributions and urn draws (top) and structured outputs (bottom), in median excess TV. Trained values are means over seeds, and reductions give the range over seeds: three for the opinion tasks, two for uniform sibling targets, and one for non-uniform sibling targets. The structured-output targets are evaluated on 60 test graphs.
blocks.zh: 表10:以超电视中位数表示的意见分布和骨灰图(上)和结构化产出(下)。 受过训练的价值观是战胜种子的手段,而减少则使范围超越种子:三项是意见任务,两项是统一的兄弟目标,一项是非统一的兄弟目标。 结构化产出目标通过60个测试图表进行评估。

blocks.en: The opinion prompts state the answer options, name them as the valid outcomes, and list the target probability of each option to three decimals. The implicit variant removes the probability line. Each opinion prompt is evaluated with n = 250 n=250 draws instead of 500 500 . The training set has 1,600 1{,}600 prompts, 800 800 from urn draws and 800 800 from GlobalOpinionQA, and the test set has 200 200 prompts from each task. The urn prompts describe 1,000 1{,}000 urns from the Spectrum Suite, which we split at random into 800 800 training and 200 200 test urns. The split does not remove duplicates, and 4 4 test urns have the same description as a training urn. The GlobalOpinionQA prompts come from 75 75 question stems. The test prompts use 18 18 of them, and the training prompts use the other 57 57 , so no test question appears in training.
blocks.zh: 意见提示解答选项,将其命名为有效结果,并列出每个选项的目标概率到小数点后三个. 隐性变体去除概率线. 每个意见提示以 n = 250 n = 250 绘图而不是500 500 来评估。 训练集有1,600 1{,}600个提示,800800从骨灰堆抽取,800800从GlobalOpinionQA抽取,测试集有200200个提示,每个任务. 骨灰盒提示描述1000 1{,}000个骨灰盒来自Spectrum Suite,我们随机分为800800个训练和200个测试骨灰盒. 拆分不除重复,4个4个测试骨灰盒的描述与训练骨灰盒相同. GlobalOpinionQA的提示来自7575问题源. 测试提示使用其中18个18个,培训提示使用其他57个57个,因此在培训中没有出现测试问题.

blocks.en: On the test prompts of both tasks and on the NYTimes task, the trained model has lower excess TV than the best prompting method. On the test prompts, it also has lower excess TV than the best temperature. Across seeds, its paired margin in excess TV is 0.14 0.14 to 0.32 0.32 over the best prompting method and 0.19 0.19 to 0.23 0.23 over the best temperature, and every interval excludes zero. A group-scalar run on the opinion tasks stopped at step 77 77 of 600 600 , when the mean rate of valid output over the previous 20 20 steps fell below 0.5 0.5 .
blocks.zh: 在两种任务的测试提示和NYTimes任务上,训练有素的模型比最佳的提示方法有较低的超量电视. 在测试提示上,它还有比最佳温度更低的多余电视. 在整个种子中,其超标电视的配对比值为:最佳导电法0.14至0.320.32,最佳温度0.19至0.230.23,每个间隔均排除0。 在600 600个步骤中,77 77个步骤停止了执行意见任务,而前20个步骤中的有效产出平均率低于0.5 0.5。

blocks.en: We adapt the sibling-discovery task of Nagarajan et al. (2025) . In their version, the model learns the graph during training, the prompt does not show it, and the model generates two siblings together with their parent. Our prompt instead names a parent and its children and asks for one pair of siblings, so the valid outputs are all pairs of children. We state two kinds of targets over these pairs. A uniform target asks for a pair drawn uniformly at random and does not list the pairs, so the model must build them from the list of children. A non-uniform target lists each pair with its probability. The uniform target tests whether the model finds the valid outputs, and the non-uniform target tests whether it also follows the stated probabilities over them. For uniform targets, we train on 800 800 graphs with 8 8 to 20 20 children and evaluate on 60 60 test graphs with 8 8 children ( 28 28 pairs). For non-uniform targets, we train on 200 200 graphs with 6 6 children and evaluate on 60 60 test graphs of the same size.
blocks.zh: 我们适应Nagarajan等人(2025年)的姊妹发现任务。 在他们的版本中,模型在训练中学习图表,提示没有显示,模型与他们的父母一起产生两个兄弟姐妹. 我们的提示是给一个父母和孩子起名,要求一对兄弟姐妹,所以有效的产出都是两个孩子。 我们指出两种目标 过这些对。 统一的目标要求随机统一绘制一对,而不列出对子,因此模型必须从儿童列表中构建. 一个非统一的目标按其概率列出每一对. 统一目标测试模型是否找到有效的输出,非统一目标测试模型是否也遵循了所声明的概率. 为统一目标,我们用800 800图培训8 8至20 20名儿童,对60个测试图评估8 8名儿童(28 28对)。 对于非统一目标,我们用200个图表对6个孩子进行培训,并对60个大小相同的测试图表进行评估。

blocks.en: On uniform targets, training removes 35 % 35\% and 39 % 39\% of the excess TV in two seeds, compared with 5 % 5\% for the best decoding baseline and 8 % 8\% for the group-scalar reward, which reaches 0.523 0.523 . Training also raises the median fraction of valid pairs that the model produces at least once in 500 500 draws from 0.71 0.71 to 0.93 0.93 (first seed), so the trained model finds more of the valid outputs. On non-uniform targets, training removes 47 % 47\% of the excess TV, compared with 14 % 14\% for the best decoding baseline.
blocks.zh: 在统一目标方面,培训取消了两种种子中35%的35%和39%的多余电视,而最佳解码基线为5%的5%和团体薪级奖励为8%的8%,达到0.523 0.523。 训练还将模型在500500中至少生产一次的有效配对的中位数从0.71 0.71提高到0.93 0.93(第一种子),因此经过训练的模型发现更多的有效产出. 在非统一目标方面,培训取消了47%的多余电视,而最佳解码基线为14%的电视。
